verdict.rationale: Data-use and AI-training privacy controls are a fair question for any app that collects user data, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of an AI-training opt-out. The only related items are an opt-in Usage Data toggle and diagnostic logs that stay local until feedback is sent. These are adjacent telemetry controls, not a documented control over AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
